# Gold Signal Simulator

Gold Signal Simulator is an educational multi-asset dashboard covering spot gold, silver, gold-mining shares, gold and silver ETFs, and gold-backed cryptoassets.

Core rule:
- 0–2 consecutive lower daily closes: HOLD
- 3–4 consecutive lower daily closes: 50% BUY / WATCH
- 5 or more consecutive lower daily closes: 100% BUY / STRONG

The percentage labels are rule stages, not probabilities, guarantees, or individualized position-size recommendations.

Primary pages:
- /index.html — charts, signals, backtests, ratios, watchlist and comparison
- /methodology.html — calculation rules, limitations and version history
- /privacy.html — local storage and third-party data disclosures

All content is educational and does not constitute financial advice.
